Loading packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)
library(janitor)
```

Creating dataframe
```{r}
killi <- read_csv("../Data/VOX_Killifish.csv",
                  locale = locale(encoding = "Windows-1252")) #this is because of the special characters in excel

str(killi)
```

cleaning names
```{r}
killi <- killi %>%
  clean_names()
```

converting predictors to factors
```{r}
killi <- killi %>%
  mutate(across(c(acclimation_temperature_c,
                  acclimation_salinity_ppt,
                  test_temperature_c),
                as.factor))
```

```{r}
responses <- c(
  "resting_metabolic_rate_mmol_o_g_min",
  "maximal_metabolic_rate_mmol_o_g_min",
  "aerobic_scope_mmol_o_g_min",
  "maximal_cox_activity_mmol_mg_protein_min",
  "maximal_cs_activity_mmol_mg_protein_min",
  "maximal_ldh_activity_mmol_mg_protein_min"
)
```

```{r}
models <- map(responses, ~ {

  df <- killi %>%
    select(
      all_of(.x),
      acclimation_temperature_c,
      acclimation_salinity_ppt,
      test_temperature_c,
      fish_id_number
    ) %>%
    na.omit()

  lmer(
    as.formula(paste0(
      .x,
      " ~ acclimation_temperature_c * acclimation_salinity_ppt + 
          acclimation_temperature_c * test_temperature_c +  
          acclimation_salinity_ppt * test_temperature_c +
         (1 | fish_id_number)"
    )),
    data = df
  )
})

names(models) <- responses
```

```{r}

```


Results table
```{r}
library(broom.mixed)

results <- purrr::map_df(names(models), ~ {
  broom.mixed::tidy(models[[.x]])
}, .id = "response")
results <- purrr::map_df(names(models), function(x) {
  broom.mixed::tidy(models[[x]]) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(response = x)
})
```
